app.title: AniTala
app.subtitle: Adapting Farms with NASA Data
app.tagline: Science-backed crop rotation decision support for smallholder farmers and extension workers.

conditions.overridePrompt: Does your field soil differ? Click to override:
conditions.waterSourceSubtitle: Select the primary water regime for this parcel to adjust dry-season feasibility.
conditions.waterAccessHint: Heuristic dry-season adjustments: rainfed plots penalize high-water crops during dry months; irrigated plots support continuous cropping.
conditions.plotNotesPlaceholder: e.g. Near secondary canal turnout; lower parcel corner prone to waterlogging after heavy rain...

priorities.title: Field History & Farmer Priorities
priorities.subtitle: Tailor the recommendation engine to your specific field and economic goals.
priorities.recentCrop: What crop was harvested in the previous season?
priorities.excludeCrops: Exclude specific crops you do not wish to grow:
priorities.soilHealthDesc: Promotes biological N-fixation, deep taproot aeration, and stover biomass.
priorities.waterResilienceDesc: Protects against dry spells and optimizes irrigation conservation.
priorities.stableIncomeDesc: Balances high-value commercial cash crops with market security.
priorities.lowInputCostDesc: Prioritizes low chemical input and economical seed requirements.
priorities.lowLaborDesc: Prevents labor bottlenecks and simplifies field operations.
priorities.climateRiskDesc: Favors crops with high heat tolerance and typhoon flood resistance.
priorities.lowCropWarning: Fewer than 2 crops selected. At least 2 crops are recommended to generate diverse rotation plans.
priorities.suggestedCropsDesc: Top matches are highlighted based on your priorities — tap any crop to include or exclude it from your plan.
priorities.diseaseBreakRationale: Helps AniTala prevent disease cycles and select the optimal biological rotation break.
priorities.generateRationale: Builds and ranks multi-season crop rotation plans from your selected crops and farm priorities. Ranked via S.I.-assisted agronomic scoring using public climate & soil datasets.

results.title: Ranked 3-Season Rotation Plans
results.subtitle: Evaluated against local NASA agro-climatology and farmer priorities.
results.noPlans: No rotations matched your constraints. Try clearing crop exclusions.
results.savedPlansEmpty: No saved plans yet. Click "Save Plan" on any rotation plan to keep it for quick reference.
results.otherGoodPlansSub: Alternative adaptive rotations evaluated for your field conditions.
results.traitFamilyDesc: Alternating botanical plant families breaks soil-borne pest and pathogen cycles like bacterial wilt and nematodes.
results.traitNFixerDesc: Legume nodule bacteria convert atmospheric nitrogen into plant-available soil nutrients, fixing 35–100 kg N/ha.
results.traitWaterDesc: Indicates relative seasonal water requirement to prevent deficit stress during dry periods.
results.traitRootDesc: Alternating root depths between shallow fibrous roots and deep taproots prevents plow pan subsoil compaction.

print.title: AniTala Crop Rotation Advisory Plan
print.notice: This advisory is generated using NASA Earth Observation telemetry and agronomic rotation principles. Validate with local municipal agriculturist.

land.title: Land and terrain summary
land.invalidCoordinates: Enter valid latitude (−90 to 90) and longitude (−180 to 180).
land.unavailable: Municipal land profiles are unavailable. Retry when local sample files can be reached.
land.telemetryUnavailable: Climate or soil data could not be loaded for this location. You can retry.
land.syntheticNotice: Synthetic municipal examples · Needs local verification
land.sampleNotice: Municipal sample data · Needs local verification
land.proxy: {hub} · Municipal proxy {distance} km from the selected point
land.limitations: These illustrative indicators require review with a local agricultural technician. Field conditions can differ from the municipal profile.
land.gridReference: SRTM pilot grid: {hub}; the selected native cell is used.
land.realLimitations: Historical terrain and quality-filtered vegetation support preliminary screens. Flood likelihood and annual erosion rates are not established. Reference-point vegetation may differ from the selected field.
land.nativeElevation: Nearest native SRTM post; no field-survey accuracy implied
land.hornSlope: Horn 3 × 3 slope with WGS84 metric spacing; percent gradient
land.qualityNdvi: Already-scaled MOD13Q1.061; conservative land-only QA; monthly means require ≥3 accepted composites across ≥2 years. Composite start month is used; cloudy gaps remain unavailable.
land.qualityNdviTrend: OLS trend requires five annual profiles, each with all 12 months and ≥16 accepted composites. Insufficient coverage remains unavailable.
land.ndviCoverage: NDVI quality check: {accepted} of {total} composites accepted (2020–2024). Cloud, water and other rejected observations are excluded; missing months remain unavailable.

provenance.title: Data sources & limitations
provenance.derived: Derived classifications and estimates require local review.
provenance.chart: Monthly rainfall and maximum temperature · source period shown above
provenance.phReview: Verify pH interpretation for the crop locally

methods.precipitation: Daily mean × month length; monthly sums for seasons/year
methods.temperature: Monthly means; annual mean of monthly values
methods.maximumTemperature: Highest daily Tmax per calendar month across the source period
methods.minimumTemperature: Illustrative T2M minus 5 °C; not fetched T2M_MIN
methods.solarRadiation: Mean of daily radiation by month
methods.humidity: Mean of daily humidity by month
methods.heatStressDays: Fixed illustrative indicator; not an observed daily count
methods.rainfallTrend: Fixed illustrative trend; not an observed fitted trend
methods.drainage: Texture & SRTM slope drainage estimate (preliminary); field validation needed
methods.organicMatter: Derived from SoilGrids SOC via Van Bemmelen (OM% ≈ SOC% × 1.724); laboratory test recommended
methods.phosphorusFixationRisk: Local pH-based screen; not a Bray-2 phosphorus test
methods.depthMean: Unweighted mean of returned depth predictions
methods.missingDefault: Contains numeric substitutes for missing observations
methods.emergencyClimate: Synthetic emergency monthly example, not acquired observations. Rainfall totals sum the monthly values; temperature averages monthly means. Heat counts, trends and risk classes are illustrative placeholders requiring local review.

observedMethods.precipitation: Mean totals from complete calendar years; missing rainfall days exclude a year, with no zero filling.
observedMethods.temperature: Daily means over accepted complete calendar years.
observedMethods.maximumTemperature: Highest daily maximum in each calendar month across the source period; seasonal values are extremes, not typical monthly highs.
observedMethods.minimumTemperature: Actual T2M_MIN averaged by calendar month; missing minima remain unavailable.
observedMethods.solarRadiation: Calendar-month daily mean with at least 80% observed coverage; no numeric substitutes.
observedMethods.humidity: Calendar-month daily mean with at least 80% observed coverage; no numeric substitutes.
observedMethods.heatStressDays: Mean annual count of days with Tmax ≥35°C in complete years. This screening threshold requires local crop review.
observedMethods.rainfallTrend: OLS on accepted complete annual totals and their actual years, expressed as % per decade. Descriptive only; no forecast or statistical significance claim.
observedMethods.risk: Preliminary rainfall, dry-spell and heat screens for complete wet/dry cycles using the shared planning calendar shown above. The team calendar and thresholds require local validation. Rainfall does not establish field flood hazard.

localReview.title: Information Gaps & Local Review Checklist
localReview.municipal: Municipal sample references used: {sources}. Confirm how these locations differ from this field.
localReview.synthetic: Some inputs or indicators are illustrative or synthetic. Verify them before using this plan for field decisions.
localReview.cached: Some inputs came from cache. Check the observation period; the cache date does not make the observations current.
localReview.override: Farmer-reported inputs replace only the selected fields. Confirm those inputs and any derived soil classification with a local technician.
localReview.unavailable: Some sources, spatial resolutions, observation dates or datasets are unavailable. Review the data-source details rather than assuming parcel-level certainty.
localReview.ndviTrend: An annual NDVI trend is unavailable. Monthly greenness patterns alone do not establish a year-to-year trend.
localReview.review: Source assumptions, derived classes and risk thresholds need local scientific review. Treat the scores as advisory comparisons.
localReview.cropReview: Some crop profiles need review. Confirm locally appropriate varieties, growing periods and agronomic assumptions.
localReview.pixelScale: Regional context: POWER meteorology 0.5° × 0.625°; SRTM ~30 m; MODIS NDVI / SoilGrids 250 m nominal. These are not parcel measurements. SMAP products commonly use 9–36 km grids; SMAP is not integrated here.
localReview.canalTurnouts: Check canal turnouts, irrigation schedules and drainage access with the local irrigation or agriculture office.
localReview.compaction: Inspect possible plow-pan compaction and confirm soil measurements before deciding on field operations.
localReview.buyerPrices: For the crops in this plan ({crops}), check local buyer prices, market access, labor and input costs. Income scores are not price or yield forecasts.

dataQuality.provisionalDetail: Provisional comparison: some evidence is missing, illustrative or awaiting local verification. Fit scores compare the supplied inputs; they are not confidence percentages or forecasts.
dataQuality.missingSoil: Required soil inputs are unavailable. Ranking is paused until texture, drainage, pH and the organic-matter class are available. Check the field conditions and any overrides with a local agricultural technician.
dataQuality.scenarioInterpretation: The five scenarios are rule-based sensitivity comparisons, not forecasts or scientific certification. Scenario stability describes the supplied inputs only. Plans remain provisional when evidence is missing, illustrative or awaiting local verification.
dataQuality.invalidPh: Enter a pH greater than 0 and no more than 14.
dataQuality.phHint: Enter a field or laboratory reading. It will be labeled farmer-reported and still needs local verification. Reset overrides to return to the source profile.
dataQuality.loading: Loading field data. Recommendations will appear after the available inputs have been checked.
dataQuality.missingTelemetry: Climate or soil data is unavailable. Return to Locate Farm and select the location again to retry.
dataQuality.noPrintablePlan: No advisory is available to print yet.
dataQuality.usingMunicipalBaseline: Using Municipal Agricultural Baseline (field test recommended)

soilModel.relocatedReference: The selected location has missing model data (cell {cell}). Soil predictions use a nearby model reference cell ({distance} km away), not measurements at your selected point. Land cover and the cause of missing data have not been verified.
soilModel.title: SoilGrids model extract · 250 m cells
soilModel.coverage: Packaged area: {grid}; selected cell {cell}. Coverage is a 2.25 × 2.25 km grid around the pilot point, not the entire municipality.
soilModel.limits: These are historical soil-model predictions, not live measurements. Confirm drainage and organic matter separately. Topsoil bulk density does not establish subsoil compaction.
soilModel.retrieved: Raster data acquired {date}; this is not an observation date
soilModel.uncertainty: Q05 and Q95 are the model’s 5th and 95th percentiles for each depth. They describe prediction uncertainty, not field-test accuracy. No combined 0–15 cm uncertainty interval is calculated.
soilModel.original: Original model values, before farmer overrides
soilModel.weightedMean: Profile values use (0–5 cm mean × 5 + 5–15 cm mean × 10) ÷ 15. Both depths are required. Texture uses existing local thresholds and needs verification.
soilModel.notInferred: Missing or unsupported field property; no value inferred
soilModel.download: Download source raster subsets and provenance
soilModel.depthMean: 0–15 cm estimate; depth means weighted by thickness (5:10)
soilModel.noPredictions: No usable soil predictions are available in this cell or the searched nearby cells. Enter verified field observations below or use the labeled municipal baseline.
soilModel.nearestValidCell: Selected cell {requestedCell} has incomplete model data; showing nearby 250 m model reference cell {usedCell} (~{meters} m away). Land cover and the cause of missing data are unverified. Confirm conditions at your selected point.

mvp.modeHelp: Missing required soil inputs use editable example assumptions so you can explore rotation plans. Available source readings stay unchanged. This is not a field-verified recommendation.
mvp.fieldHelp: Only source data and your reported inputs are used. Missing required soil inputs can pause ranking.
mvp.assumptionMethod: Editable demo defaults only: clay loam, pH 6.3, moderate drainage, medium organic matter when that input is missing. Not inferred from satellite readings.
mvp.soilNotice: Missing properties use example assumptions for this demonstration. Edit any field below; your inputs take priority. Source predictions remain available in details.
mvp.printNotice: DEMONSTRATION PLAN — example soil assumptions were used. Edit and locally verify these inputs before field decisions.
mvp.landDetails: Technical details and annual NDVI trend
mvp.lowlandOutside: Outside this lowland screen; flood risk not assessed
mvp.lowlandMethod: Team screening rule: elevation <30 m and slope ≤3%. Historical surface terrain only; does not establish flood likelihood, drainage or safety. Requires local review.
mvp.bareMethod: Possible low-greenness months: quality-approved monthly NDVI <0.25 in January–June. Partial coverage is disclosed; no cloud filling, crop or bare-soil confirmation.
mvp.noLowGreenness: No months below 0.25 in the observed January–June data
mvp.noLandNdvi: No usable land observations after quality screening
mvp.screenLimit: These are preliminary screens, not flood maps or erosion rates. Rain, soil, cover and management also matter. Missing or rejected vegetation observations are not bare fields.
mvp.exampleNdvi: View an illustrative seasonal vegetation example
mvp.exampleNdviHelp: Separate synthetic municipal example, January–December. These values illustrate the workflow and do not replace the selected pixel or rejected NASA observations.

erosion.gentle: Gentle slope (≤3%); lower slope contribution, not a measured erosion rate
erosion.sloping: Sloping terrain (>3–15%); review cover and runoff control
erosion.steep: Steep terrain (>15%); prioritize local erosion and cover assessment

mvp.erosionMethod: Qualitative team screen from slope only: ≤3%, >3–15%, >15%. No RUSLE tonnes/ha/year is calculated; rainfall, soil, cover and management require separate evidence.
